title: Relative flatness of the specified finite affine Cech terms
statement: Let $f:X\to T$ be separated [def-pc-morphism-conventions], with $T$ affine, and $F$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module flat over $f$ [def-pc-scheme-module-flat-over]. Let $V:\operatorname{Fin}(r)\to X.\mathrm{Opens}$ consist of affine opens. Every integer-degree term of the specified complex $C(f,F,V)$ [def-pc-finite-affine-cech-model] is flat over $\operatorname{id}_T$. No covering condition, quasi-coherence of $F$, or cohomology comparison is asserted.

proof.text: The canonical affine base chart is an isomorphism. Separatedness over the affine base makes all nonempty finite intersections affine. Evaluate relative flatness on such an intersection and the top affine base open. Restrict scalars through GammaSpecIso and use flatness transitivity along a ring isomorphism. Finite products of the resulting flat modules are flat, via the dependent direct-sum equivalence DFinsupp.linearEquivFunOnFintype. Outside natural degrees the extension is zero.

In each integer degree, transport section flatness along extendXIso if it comes from a natural degree. Otherwise isZero_extend_X and scalar restriction give a zero, hence free and flat module. Apply flatOver_affineAssociatedModule to this specified flat global-ring module. Its associated sheaf pulled back along T.toSpecGamma is definitionally the term of finiteAffineCechModel.

theorem finiteAffineCechModel_flatOver {X T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ T)
    [IsAffine T] [IsSeparated f] (F : X.Modules) (hF : F.IsFlatOver f)
    {r : ℕ} (V : Fin r → X.Opens) (hV : ∀ i, IsAffineOpen (V i)) :
    ∀ n : ℤ, ((finiteAffineCechModel f F V).X n).IsFlatOver (𝟙 T)
